donor.name: redacts provider, user, lead, consent, token, session, and email values from output

keeper.name: applies only when confirmation exactly matches the target

actualFailure: CLI receipt leaks one of the original eight sensitive literals or loses the fixed amount/currency; keeper independently preserves apply/guard and exact verify→activate→read order.
sameInput: Both callbacks call fakeDeps() with no overrides, then parse the identical ordered Stripe provider/session/apply/confirm-session argv, then call runOneTimeRecoveryCommand once. nonTestCaller: scripts/billing/one-time-recover.ts main() calls parseOneTimeRecoveryArgs then runOneTimeRecoveryCommand with createLiveOneTimeRecoveryDependencies; package.json billing:one-time:recover and docs/runbooks/one-time-payment-recovery.md expose that operator entry.
history: Both donor and keeper were introduced in 0d29b871 (#293), 2026-08-01. Guarded provider reset was added by 2518d54e (#303); no stopped-experiment retirement inferred.
